name: Shree Heights
default_objective: High-income individuals associated with Chandannagar who may be suitable prospects for a premium ₹70 lakh-plus residential property, including senior corporate executives, doctors, lawyers, chartered accountants and established entrepreneurs, even if they currently live in another city.

location_affinity_types: Works or practices in Chandannagar / Hooghly
Chandannagar native or alumnus currently working in Bangalore / Mumbai / Kolkata
Historic or family residential association with Hooghly district
search_parameters.default_prompt: High-income individuals, senior professionals, doctors, CAs, and business owners associated with Chandannagar

qualification_parameters.seniority_requirement: Consultant / Partner / Senior Executive / Director level
qualification_parameters.evidence_completeness: Named individual with verified direct contact channel (phone/email/LinkedIn) and verifiable geographic tie to Chandannagar or Hooghly.
disqualifiers: Generic corporate info boxes without named decision-maker

ai_evaluation_criteria.evaluation_focus: Evaluate individual professional standing, stability, and credible affinity to Chandannagar. Distinguish between actual resident, commuter, or native roots. State explicitly that purchasing capacity is an evidenced research proxy rather than confirmed intent.
ai_evaluation_criteria.uncertainty_policy: Flag unverified financial capacity and lack of explicit property-buying interest as open uncertainties.

notes: Local geography is a research proxy only; vehicle or business ownership never establishes residential purchase intent.
